title: Outcome-driven quarterly lanes for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Riya Patel
description: Objective: Create a reusable, outcome-driven quarterly planning lane specifically for the Hosted API + Model Catalog that ties initiatives directly to OKRs, capacity guardrails, and canary rollout windows. Rationale: previous quarters focused heavily on feature lists; this ticket formalizes an outcomes-first template so PMs and Eng can make trade-offs against capacity and measurable KPIs. Scope: define the lane structure (Outcome, Key Results, Initiatives, Risks), cadence (planning, mid-cycle check, canary windows), gating (eval sets, perf regressions, SLO impact), and a lightweight runbook for rollouts and emergency rollback. Deliverables: a Q2 lane template, roadmap commitments for top 3 initiatives, a canary calendar, and a short-runbook for coordinated model rotations across hosted tiers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Lane template doc published in Confluence and linked from Console roadmap UI
2) Top 3 initiatives have owners, milestones and dependencies identified
3) Canary calendar for model rotations with fallback policies agreed by Eng and SRE
4) Evaluation gate defined (prompt set + perf thresholds) and test harness accepted by Research
5) OKR mapping documented: primary metric, baseline, target and expected impact on cost/SLOs
milestones: 2026-01-20: Draft lane template complete (owner: Riya Patel)
2026-01-28: Cross-functional review with Eng/SRE/Design (owner: Ethan Moore)
2026-02-08: Final commitments published and linked in roadmap UI (owner: PM team)
2026-02-22: Canary calendar & runbook sign-off (owner: SRE lead)
2026-03-15: Mid-cycle check-in and metric baseline capture (owner: Analytics)
risks: Model compatibility regressions during rotation could increase error rates: need eval gate and canary windows
Capacity shortage if Dedicated autoscaling and Hosted burst policies diverge from assumptions
Stakeholder misalignment on priority could push critical infra work out of the lane
runbook_summary: Short checklist for rollout: 1) pre-canary eval on baseline prompt set; 2) small-region canary with traffic cap 1-5%; 3) monitor token-level latency, p99 tail, and quality regressions for 12 hours; 4) automated rollback threshold triggers; 5) post-mortem if threshold crossed.
metrics_kpis: Primary OKR metric: Hosted API latency p50/p95 improvement by 10% for targeted models
Secondary: unit cost per 1k tokens for model-catalog top 10 workloads <= baseline + 5%
Safety KPI: no increase >0.5% in API error rate after model rotation
Operational KPI: Canary rollback rate <= 10% across Q2
